Why clean ducts matter in a beach community

Pacific Beach has a set of air quality challenges that many inland neighborhoods do not see.

  • Salt and moisture Salt crystals and humid air can stick to dust inside ducts. That layer holds more particles and odors.
  • Beach sand and fine dust Open windows and doors invite in grains and grit. It all ends up in filters and ducts.
  • Pets and shared living PB is full of dog walkers along the boardwalk. Pet dander and hair collect quickly in return ducts.
  • Busy kitchens and bars Restaurants along Garnet and Mission generate grease particles that float into rooftop units and ducts.
  • Construction and remodels Ongoing updates in older homes near Cass and Fanuel kick up drywall dust that finds its way into the system.

Clean ducts help with indoor air quality, comfort, and energy use. You also get less dust on furniture and fewer odors. If you rent your place on weekends, fresh smelling air can help your guests feel good the moment they step in.

Curious about what is in your ducts? Ask to see our camera footage. Many clients are surprised at what we vacuum out.

Signs your ducts need attention

  • A puff of dust comes out when the system starts
  • Musty or salty odors that do not go away after cleaning the home
  • More dust on surfaces only a day or two after cleaning
  • Allergy or asthma flare ups indoors
  • Hot and cold spots between rooms
  • Rising energy bills with no change in use
  • Noisy airflow or whistling at vents
  • Visible dust buildup on supply registers or the return grille

Do any of these sound familiar? Call {{phone}} or visit skycleanair.com to book an inspection.

Our duct cleaning process

We keep it simple, clean, and thorough.

  • 1. Walkthrough and inspection

    We look at supply and return runs, check the air handler, and evaluate access points.

    If needed, we run a video scope to show buildup in the ducts.

  • 2. Set up and protect

    We cover floors and furniture near work areas.

    We seal off registers and set up a negative pressure machine with HEPA filtration.

  • 3. Agitation and vacuum

    We use rotary brushes or air whips to break debris loose.

    The HEPA vacuum pulls dust and contaminants out to our sealed collection unit.

  • 4. Grille and register cleaning

    We remove and clean supply registers and the return grille.

    We hand clean vent openings for a tidy finish.

  • 5. Optional treatments

    Duct sanitizing to reduce odors and microbial growth.

    Coil and blower cleaning to restore airflow and improve efficiency.

    Filter upgrades for better capture of fine particles.

  • 6. Final check

    We reassemble, test airflow, and review before and after results with you.

Want to see what we removed from your ducts? We can show you the collection bin. It is oddly satisfying.

How often should you schedule cleaning

  • Typical PB home every 3 to 5 years
  • Near the beach or boardwalk closer to every 2 to 3 years
  • After a remodel soon after construction dust settles
  • After smoke events once outdoor air improves
  • Heavy pet households or short term rentals every 2 years

If you notice musty odors, dust puffs, or allergies, move that timetable up.
